correctness.rationale: For each pair of distinct vertices in X (and likewise Y), the complete distinguishing set is exactly that pair. This proves the necessary omission bounds, forces X union Y into every 2-metric generator, and rules out k>=3. The converse is proved by a complete vertex-pair case split using d(x,c_i)=i+1 and its right-side analogue. The polynomial formulas then follow by direct subset factorization. Exhaustive replay over p,q=3..5, ell=1..3, k=1,2,3 checks 65,856 subsets against the literal distance definition; the computation is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
